reader.title: Subexponential bound in treewidth under ETH · Fixed number of colors

sourceBasis.step: For fixed q, add a clique of q−3 vertices adjacent to every vertex of the 3-Coloring instance. These vertices use q−3 colors and increase treewidth by at most q−3. The new graph has at most q colors exactly when the original graph has at most three.

statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm decides Chromatic Number within the stated running time.
